subject: Role claim reconciliation and SCIM delta package for SOC 2 intake
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bridgewellhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@bridgewellhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Role claim reconciliation and SCIM delta package for SOC 2 intake

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick kickoff call yesterday. As part of our SOC 2 intake we need a compact package of IAM artifacts to validate authorization controls. Can you provide the following by COB Oct 28?

- Owner/role matrix (list of roles, owning team/person, description)
- SCIM delta export covering the last 90 days (created/updated/deleted events)
- A handful of SAML assertion samples (redacted where needed) that show group and role claims
- Mapping of SCIM groups to application roles (CSV or similar)
- Brief note on the least-privilege program and how role pruning is enforced (1 page max)

If any of these will be delivered via a secure share or a link, please include the access method and expected TTL. If you need more time, tell us which items require extra lead time.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
Bridgewell Health — Information Security (Vendor Intake)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bridgewellhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role claim reconciliation and SCIM delta package for SOC 2 intake

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a package that matches exactly. Tentative plan:

- Role matrix: CSV (bridgewell_role_matrix_20261019.csv)
- SCIM deltas: newline-delimited JSON (scim_deltas_90days.jsonl) with event timestamps
- SAML assertions: text file with 5 samples, PII-redacted (saml_assertion_samples.txt)
- Mapping: role_mapping_minimal.csv (mapping SCIM group -> product role)
- Narrative: redaction_notes.pdf with the least-privilege summary and pruning cadence

Two quick asks:
1) Do you prefer the SCIM file as a single archive or split by week?
2) Would you like an HMAC or checksum for integrity? We can provide SHA256 sums.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min review with our security lead (Irene) and an engineer (Naomi) to walk the artifacts.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Trust (on the intake)
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Oct 19, 2026 at 11:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Two quick asks:
> 1) Do you prefer the SCIM file as a single archive or split by week?
> 2) Would you like an HMAC or checksum for integrity? We can provide SHA256 sums.

Hi all,

For most SOC reviewers a single compressed file is easiest (we'll include md5/sha256 sums and a manifest). We will:

- Produce a compressed archive with the scim_deltas_90days.jsonl and a manifest file listing record counts and checksums.
- Sanitize identifiers: we will hash user_id and email fields in the sample SAML assertions but keep the group/role claim attributes intact so you can validate mapping logic.
- Provide a short README in the archive explaining our delta generation: we run daily snapshot diffs against the primary user store; the delta record is annotated with source_change (SCIM_API | LDAP_SYNC | ADMIN_UI) and actor where available.
- For least privilege evidence: we'll include a short runbook describing how we identify stale roles (90-day inactivity heuristic + owner review) and our scheduled role-pruning pipeline.

I'll own the manifest and the redaction notes. Naomi will upload the artifacts to a secure drive with an access ACL for Bridgewell.

Irene Choi
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bridgewellhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role claim reconciliation and SCIM delta package for SOC 2 intake

Hi Elena — delivering the package below. Links are time-limited; I set expiry to 7 days by default. If you need longer retention let me know and we'll issue a scoped share.

Attachments (included in the archive and as individual files):
- bridgewell_role_matrix_20261019.csv (role,owner_email,owner_team,description)
- role_mapping_minimal.csv (group_name,product_role,notes)
- scim_deltas_90days.jsonl (newline JSON, fields: ts,event_type,resource_type,id,changes,source_change)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (5 redacted assertions; email and sub hashed)
- redaction_notes.pdf (short summary of redaction rules and least-privilege process)

Access: secure drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure/bridgewell/soc2-intake-20261019 (expires 2026-10-29)
Presigned S3 (direct download): https://s3-presigned.redwood.com/bridgewell/scim_deltas_90days.jsonl?exp=2026-10-29

Integrity: SHA256 manifest included as sha256_manifest.txt (manifest line format: filename  sha256sum)

Notes on reconciliation method:
- We run a nightly job that snapshots the canonical user store and computes per-user role membership deltas; for this package we included a 90-day window and annotated each delta with the origin (SCIM delta vs admin action).
- Role ownership is synthesized from application role metadata and our ownership ledger; where ownership is ambiguous we tag for human review (owner_note column in the CSV).
- Role pruning: roles flagged for 90-day inactivity are queued and an owner receives an automated review request (owner has 7 days to respond before role is disabled in staging).

If you want a short live walkthrough on Friday I can run through the files and the delta-generation script.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
